summary: Enhabit, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval of the merger agreement dated February 22, 2026, with Anchor Parent, LLC and Anchor Merger Sub, Inc. The merger will convert Enhabit into a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent, taking the company private. At the special meeting on May 12, 2026, 36,311,910 shares (approximately 71% of outstanding) voted for the merger versus 18,275 against, securing the required majority. No per-share price or premium was disclosed in this filing, but the definitive proxy statement likely contains those terms. The transaction is expected to close pending customary conditions. Watch for regulatory clearance and any competing bids that could emerge.
